name: get-fable
description: Portable coding lifecycle discipline and situational awareness for AI agents.

skills.description: Entry router and global execution contract.
Gather repository, environment, documentation, and load-bearing evidence before architecture.
Resolve current external facts against primary sources before they influence design or implementation.
Convert evidence into bounded work cards with explicit acceptance criteria.
Drive testable behavior changes through red, minimal implementation, green, and focused cleanup.
Delegate independent work only through explicit ownership, scope, and acceptance contracts.
Implement one accepted card with immediate acceptance checks and no scope drift.
Try to falsify the implementation and collect concrete acceptance evidence.
Review the actual diff against the requested behavior and repository standards independently from implementation.
Route security-sensitive work to threat modeling, diff review, repository audit, or finding validation as appropriate.
Establish merge or release readiness from required quality gates and current repository state.
Compact decisions, evidence, blockers, and the exact next action into durable continuation state.
Evaluate changes to prompts, skills, hooks, routers, or agent controls against baselines, holdouts, and regressions.
Diagnose repeated failure, stale execution, or contradictory evidence before another edit.
Create accessible, cohesive charts, plots, graphs, stat tiles, and data visualizations across all rendering mediums.
Design structured technical proposals, responsive artifacts, architecture diagrams, and interactive components.
Clean up code quality, simplify logic, remove dead code, and improve altitude without changing runtime behavior.
Run bounded recurring task loops, interval polling, or self-paced test cycles with explicit timeouts.
Launch and drive live applications (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser) to verify end-to-end runtime behavior.
Manage persistent file-based memory, indexing cross-session user preferences, feedback, and project constraints.
Configure agent harness settings, permissions allowlists, environment variables, keybindings, and hooks.
Verify code changes with independent oracles, contract derivation, headless UI testing, and workspace safety.
Autonomous cowork execution with silent tool chaining, outcome-first reporting, and safety boundary enforcement.
Situational awareness micro-policy predicting the smallest atomic next move without scope drift.
Author, refine, optimize, and evaluate autonomous skills for multi-agent ecosystems.
